No provider usage or completion evidence followed; records do not distinguish an unsubmitted request from a provider request stalled before completion. repository_identity_corrective.finding: Root daemon turns hardcoded TurnRunInput.repository_id to None, so TaskTool persisted repo-less child tasks even for repository-bound managed sessions.
repository_identity_corrective.correction: M011 resolves the authoritative workspace binding and propagates its resolved repository ID into TurnRunInput.

follow_up_trials_2026_10_16.conclusion: S0 proves the frozen shared-interface task can be completed by one provider-backed CodeGG agent. S1 has not completed after the repository identity correction; no single-agent versus multi-agent effectiveness conclusion is supported.

S1_group_continuation_retry.outcome: The creating turn used six bounded wait_group calls and ended while the group remained running. A subsequent top-level turn in the same session received group actor is not authorized from the pre-M012 daemon. M012 now permits this same-session continuation; restart and daemon-backed verification are still required. This is not a completed S1 result.

single_child_runtime_diagnostics.source_boundary_scope: AgentLoop records before_provider_turn before AgentStart hooks and request preparation. It does not prove that ProviderTurnAdapter invoked the provider stream or that tool execution began.
single_child_runtime_diagnostics.classification: diagnostic only; not included in benchmark arm counts or effectiveness denominators
single_child_runtime_diagnostics.finding: Child-run execution stalls are reproducible outside parallel sibling groups. Current journal evidence is too coarse to distinguish provider streaming, hooks, request preparation, or tool handling. Add phase-specific trace evidence before another expensive Rust/Python S1 attempt.

approval_mode_propagation_corrective.finding: Delegated children defaulted to Interactive even when the authorized parent TaskTool invocation used Yolo. A git_query escalation entered permission_pending in a synthetic child session that the headless parent could not resolve.
approval_mode_propagation_corrective.correction: Persist approval mode on the durable SubagentRun payload from the authorized parent invocation and apply it in the scheduled child loop. Historical missing values default to Interactive. Child agent tool/path rules and narrowed sandbox remain independent ceilings.
approval_mode_propagation_corrective.provider_milestones: Journal provider_attempt_started, provider_attempt_succeeded, and provider_attempt_failed with attempt identifiers and bounded failure classification.
approval_mode_propagation_corrective.verification: Source-built isolated daemon passed a bounded child git_query status plus workspace read under explicit parent Yolo; the following S1 children recorded only succeeded provider attempts. Focused cargo check and scheduler-bypass, approval-router, sandbox-contract, and core-boundary guards passed.
